content.text: MongoDB's $lookup aggregation stage performs a left outer join, similar to SQL JOIN.
$lookup works best when both collections fit in memory. For very large datasets, consider embedding.

questions.question: What does $lookup do?
questions.explanation: $lookup performs a join between two collections in an aggregation pipeline.
